headline: Mexico GDP: analysts see "signs of slowdown" for end of 2026
summary: Analysts at Grupo Financiero Banorte said Mexico's economy maintained a solid pace in the third quarter, though slower than in the second quarter. They pointed to signs of deceleration heading into year-end.
why: Mexico's GDP trajectory affects the peso, interest-rate expectations at Banco de México, and demand for Mexican assets.
original_headline: PIB de México: analistas ven "señales de desaceleración" para el cierre de 2026
